3. The present application under Section 483 of the BNSS seeks interim bail in case FIR No.
391/2020, under Sections 363/376/376AB/377 of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act,
registered at P.S. Amar Colony.
5. Learned Trial Court while dismissing the interim bail application of the applicant observed that the marriage card did not have any details of the venue and the verification report by the Investigating Officer further mentions the fact that only the statement of maulvi was recorded,
however, there was no caterer or Halwai booked by the family.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. The present applicant seeks interim bail on the grounds of marriage of his sister which is scheduled for 09.07.2025.
Be that as it may, the marriage is scheduled for 09.07.2025, i.e., tomorrow, at the native place of the applicant in Madhubani, Bihar.
7. In these circumstances, no ground for interim bail is made out.
8. The present application is dismissed and disposed of accordingly.
9. Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for necessary information and compliance.
10. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court forthwith.
